nodes.summary: Let $T$ be the Karatsuba cost recurrence, $T(n) = 1$ for $n \le 1$ and $T(n) = 3\,T(\lceil n/2 \rceil) + n$ for $n \ge 2$. For every natural number $n \ge 1$, $T(n) \le 9\, n^{\log_2 3}$.
nodes.title: The $n^{\log_2 3}$ bound for the Karatsuba cost recurrence

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be the Karatsuba cost recurrence, $T(n) = 1$ for $n \le 1$ and $T(n) = 3\,T(\lceil n/2 \rceil) + n$ for $n \ge 2$, and let $\ell(n)$ be the least natural number $k$ with $n \le 2^k$ (so $\ell(n) = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$ for $n \ge 1$). For every natural number $n$, $T(n) \le 3^{\ell(n) + 1}$.
nodes.title: Power-of-three bound on the Karatsuba cost recurrence

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be the Karatsuba cost recurrence, $T(n) = 1$ for $n \le 1$ and $T(n) = 3\,T(\lceil n/2 \rceil) + n$ for $n \ge 2$. For every natural number $k$, $T(2^k) + 2^{k+1} = 3^{k+1}$.
nodes.title: Karatsuba cost at powers of two

nodes.summary: The function $T$ on natural numbers defined by $T(n) = 1$ for $n \le 1$ and $T(n) = 3\,T(\lceil n/2 \rceil) + n$ for $n \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Karatsuba cost recurrence

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $a, b, c, d$, write $P = |a - b| \cdot |c - d|$. If $b \le a$ holds exactly when $d \le c$, then $ac + bd - P = ad + bc$, where the subtraction is truncated at $0$; otherwise $ac + bd + P = ad + bc$.
nodes.title: Karatsuba's middle coefficient

nodes.summary: Let $B \ge 1$ and $n$ be natural numbers, let $m = \lceil n/2 \rceil$, and let $x < B^n$ be a natural number. Then the high part $\lfloor x / B^m \rfloor$, the low part $x \bmod B^m$, and their distance $|\lfloor x / B^m \rfloor - x \bmod B^m|$ are all less than $B^m$.
nodes.title: Size bound for Karatsuba's recursive operands

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $B$, $n$, $x$ and $y$, Karatsuba multiplication of $x$ and $y$ as $n$-digit numbers in base $B$ returns $xy$.
nodes.title: Correctness of Karatsuba multiplication

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $B$, $x$, $y$ and $n \ge 1$, the cost of Karatsuba multiplication of $x$ and $y$ as $n$-digit numbers in base $B$ is at most $9\, n^{\log_2 3}$.
nodes.title: The $n^{\log_2 3}$ bound for Karatsuba multiplication

nodes.summary: Let $\ell(n)$ be the least natural number $k$ with $n \le 2^k$ (so $\ell(n) = \lceil \log_2 n \rceil$ for $n \ge 1$). For all natural numbers $B$, $n$, $x$ and $y$, the cost of Karatsuba multiplication of $x$ and $y$ as $n$-digit numbers in base $B$ is at most $3^{\ell(n) + 1}$.
nodes.title: Power-of-three bound on the cost of Karatsuba multiplication

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $B$, $n$, $x$ and $y$, the cost of Karatsuba multiplication of $x$ and $y$ as $n$-digit numbers in base $B$ equals $T(n)$, where $T$ is the Karatsuba cost recurrence, $T(n) = 1$ for $n \le 1$ and $T(n) = 3\,T(\lceil n/2 \rceil) + n$ for $n \ge 2$.
nodes.title: Cost of Karatsuba multiplication

nodes.summary: Karatsuba's algorithm on natural numbers $x$ and $y$, viewed as $n$-digit numbers in base $B$, as a computation that returns a natural number together with a cost.
